title: Manhunter #28 #29 SIGNED Marc Andreyko Lot DC 2007 Batman Wonder Woman
condition_description: Both signed by writer Marc Andreyko in black marker on the front cover and inscribed "to Robert!"; no COA. #28 has small chips and a light stain along the left edge of the cover; #29 bright with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Manhunter #28 and #29 (April and May 2007), DC Comics - both SIGNED on the front cover by writer Marc Andreyko and inscribed "to Robert!". No COA. Art by Javier Pina and Robin Riggs. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price each.

- #28: "Knight Court" - Batman guest-stars. Kevin Nowlan cover. Back cover: Ghost Rider / Sony DVD ad
- #29: "Verdict: Hostile" - Wonder Woman on trial. Back cover: Jade Empire Special Edition (PC) ad

Condition: #28 has small chips and a light stain along the left edge of the cover; #29 is bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
